messages:
alice_mc: Customer reported being billed twice after a single API call; says external webhook for invoice creation fired twice. request_id=acme-req-44.
ben_support: Sorry about that. Can you paste the runtime logs and the customer timestamp? Also asking billing to stand by.
carlos_eng: quick summary from logs: model emitted tool intent -> router forwarded to tool-proxy -> tool-proxy returned 502 -> circuit-breaker opened -> runtime fell back to non-tool text generation -> model re-emitted same tool intent -> runtime treated it as a fresh tool call and invoked tool again. Two separate call-ids, two side-effect executions.
sejal_sre: do we have the exact log snippet and timestamps to correlate with customer's event? need to reproduce.
alice_mc: pasted sanitized request and logs: 
POST /v1/outputs { model: "rwd-infer-2", input: "create invoice", idempotency_key: null }
[1718309999.10] Router -> ToolProxy call-id=a1
[1718309999.50] ToolProxy -> Router 502 call-id=a1
[1718309999.51] CircuitBreaker open for tool-A
[1718309999.95] Fallback: non-tool text path
[1718310000.04] Model -> {"name":"tool-A","args":{...}}  // tool intent emitted again
[1718310000.05] Router -> ToolProxy call-id=b2
[1718310000.35] ToolProxy -> Router 200 call-id=b2
ben_support: Customer timestamp: 2024-05-10T14:12:01Z, request id acme-req-44. Billing says two external executions = two charges.
carlos_eng: immediate root cause: runtime created separate invocations for repeated intents during fallback and there is no tool-level idempotency token.
ben_support: mitigation steps for support/billing: refund requested, open ticket, send courtesy update to customer.
infra-bot: Billing ticket created: TICKET-3482 (refund requested).
sejal_sre: engineering remediation: (1) short-term de-dupe: when a fallback occurs, record the original tool-intent signature in the request context and map identical intents within 2s to the original call-id; (2) require/propagate idempotency_key for external tool actions in next release; (3) add smoke/regression test asserting single external side-effect under fallback conditions.
carlos_eng: repro plan for eng: mock tool-proxy to return 502 for first invocation, allow second. Force model to emit the tool intent twice (or mock model output). Run in staging and assert external side-effect call count == 1 after de-dupe patch.
sejal_sre: add metric alert to detect >1 external side-effect per request_id within 5s window.
ben_support: drafted customer message: "We found a duplicate execution triggered by a fallback/retry interaction. We will refund and are implementing a hotfix to prevent recurrence."
alice_mc: customer thanked us and asked what we will do so others don't hit this. Please prioritize.
carlos_eng: timeline estimate: 48h hotfix for de-dupe + staging verification; 1 week for full idempotency propagation to tool-proxy and docs.
ben_support: tagging billing and trust for refund confirmation and any downstream notices.
alice_mc: will follow up once refund confirmed. keeping this thread open for updates. :pray:
